testing/time#

A clock for tests that moves only when told.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let clock = ManualClock(Instant(Duration(seconds: 1700000000.rat())));
let waiting = cache.expire_later(clock);
clock.advance(Duration(seconds: (5 * 60).rat()));        // wakes what waited up to then

Description#

A clock for tests that moves only when told.

It works only inside a test.

Public API#

object ManualClock#

object ManualClock does Timing

Test-context-only owner, no host clock or sleeping. State publication precedes every wake. Nested advance during wake dispatch is explicitly rejected.
